59800.meaning2: having made ascend, having put on, having entrusted

examples.text: 316, 331. nāmānaṃ samāso yutt'attho.
digussa samāsassa ekattaṃ hoti, napuṃsakaliṅgattañ'ca.
iti nāmakappe samāsakappo sattamo kaṇḍo. samāsakappo niṭṭhito.
sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, sattā gacchanti suggatin'ti.

59805.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of samāsa

examples.text: sāsan'atthaṃ samuddiṭṭhaṃ, may'ākhyātaṃ samāsato, sakaṃ buddhivisesena, cintayantu vicakkhaṇā.
nadīantā ca kattuantā ca kapaccayo hoti samās'ante. bahū nadiyo yasmiṃ so'yaṃ bahunadiko, janapado. bahavo kattāro yassa so'yaṃ bahukattuko, puriso.
dhanumhā ca āpaccayo hoti samās'ante. gāṇḍīvo dhanu yassa so'yaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvā.

59808.meaning1: (gram) situated at the end of a compound

examples.text: 337, 350. kvaci samās'antagatānam'akār'anto.

samās'antagatānaṃ nāmānam'anto saro kvaci akāro hoti. devānaṃ rājā devarājo, devarājā, devānaṃ sakhā devasakho, devasakhā, pañca ahāni pañc'āhaṃ, satt'āhaṃ, pañcagavaṃ, chatt'upāhanaṃ, upasaradaṃ, visāl'akkho, vimukho.

59810.meaning2: associates, keeps close company; lit. causes to sit together (with)
59810.commentary: (SNa) samāsethā'ti saha nisīdeyya. desanāsīsam'eva c'etaṃ, sabbairiyāpathe sabbhi'r'eva saha kubbeyyā'ti attho. (THa) samāsethā'ti samaṃ āsetha saha vaseyya. te payirupāsanto tesaṃ sussūsanto diṭṭh'ānugatiñ'ca āpajjanto samānavāso bhaveyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: sambhi'r'eva samāsetha, paṇḍiteh'atthadassibhi, atthaṃ mahantaṃ gambhīraṃ, duddasaṃ nipuṇaṃ aṇuṃ, dhīrā samadhigacchanti, appamattā vicakkhaṇā'ti.

59811.meaning2: having associated, having combined, having abridged

examples.text: sati gīvā siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchisamāvāso, viveko tassa vāladhi.
tassa kho pana, pāpima, mahānirayassa tayo nāmadheyyā honti, chaphass'āyataniko iti'pi, saṅkusamāhato iti'pi, paccattavedaniyo iti'pi.
evaṃ bhoge samāhatvā, alam'atto kule gihī, catudhā vibhaje bhoge, sa ve mittāni ganthati.
evaṃ bhoge samāharitvā, alam'atto kule gihī, catudhā vibhaje bhoge, sa ve mittāni ganthati.

59823.meaning1: (gram) copulative compound with plural meaning and singular ending
59823.meaning2: (gram) copulative compound with plural meaning and singular termination

59824.meaning1: meditatively composed; centred; collected; settled; steadied
59824.commentary: (SNa) samāhito'ti upacārena vā appanāya vā samāhito. (ANa) samāhitassā'ti ek'aggacittassa. (THa) samāhitan'ti aṭṭhavidhena samādhinā maggaphalasamādhinā ca samāhitaṃ.

examples.text: bāhitvā sabbapāpakāni, vimalo sādhusamāhito ṭhit'atto, saṃsāram'aticca kevalī so, asito tādi pavuccate sa brahmā.
samāhitassa-ayaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa

59825.synonym: upeta, parikkhata, saparikkhata, samaṅga, samaṅgī, samannāgata, samāgata, samāyuta, sampanna, saṃyutta

examples.text: yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.
saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino samāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ evaṃ pajānissati, anamataggo kho saṃsāro.

59827.meaning1: meditatively composed; internally settled; inwardly focused

examples.text: yathācārī yathāsato satīmā, yatasaṅkappajjhāyi appamatto, ajjhattarato samāhit'atto, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.
okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciy'ūpachinde.

59828.meaning1: with composed faculties; with collected mind

examples.text: yo ve kilesāni pahāya pañca, paripuṇṇasekho aparihānadhammo, cetovasippatto samāhit'indriyo, sa ve ṭhit'atto'ti naro pavuccati.

atītam'pi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātuso'va sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu. hīn'ādhimuttikā hīn'ādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu, kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikā kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.
puna nāradakūṭamhi, pavivekagate jine, khīṇ'āsavā vītamalā, samiṃsu satakoṭiyo.

59830.meaning1: achieves; succeeds; prospers; works out well
59830.commentary: (NIDD1) samijjhatī'ti ijjhati samijjhati labhati paṭilabhati adhigacchati vindatī'ti, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati. (SNPa) tassa ce taṃ samijjhatī'ti tassa kāmayamānassa sattassa taṃ kāmasaṅkhātaṃ vatthu samijjhati ce, sace so taṃ labhatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (THa) adhippāyo samijjhatū'ti kad'āhaṃ viharissāmi, katakicco anāsavo'ti evaṃ pavatto manoratho ijjhatu siddhiṃ pāpuṇātu.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kamm'ante payojeyya. tassa te kamm'antā samijjheyyuṃ
kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati, addhā pītimano hoti, laddhā macco yadicchati.

59833.meaning1: succeeded; prospered; worked out; was successful

examples.text: ahaṃ kho pubbe iṇaṃ ādāya kamm'ante payojesiṃ, tassa me te kamm'antā samijjhiṃsu

59834.meaning2: having succeeded, having prospered, having taken effect

examples.text: selo yathā ekaghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ nindāpasaṃsāsu, na samiñjanti paṇḍitā.

59836.meaning1: bends back; folds back; flexes back

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, brahmā sahampati, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evam'eva, brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.
hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.

59838.meaning1: flexing and stretching; bending and straightening

examples.text: hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.

59839.meaning1: bends back; folds back; flexes back

examples.text: yataṃ care yataṃ tiṭṭhe, yataṃ acche yataṃ saye, yataṃ samiñjaye bhikkhu, yatam'enaṃ pasāraye.
so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ

59841.meaning1: bent back; folded back; flexed back

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, brahmā sahampati, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evam'eva, brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.

59842.meaning1: should be bent back; should be folded back

examples.text: evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban'ti.

59843.meaning2: having bent back; having folded back; having flexed back

examples.text: samit'āssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā
vihari apekkhaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, yo vedagū samito yat'atto, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, lokassa jaññā udayabbayañ'cā'ti.
n'atthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi gosamitaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi sūriyasamā ābhā, samuddaparamā sarā'ti.
yo ca sameti pāpāni, aṇuṃ thūlāni sabbaso, samitattā hi pāpānaṃ, samaṇo'ti pavuccati.

59847.meaning1: with passions cooled; with defilements settled

examples.text: atha ce pabbajati bhavati vipāpo, samaṇo samitarajo vivaṭṭacchado, vigatadarathakilamatho, imam'api ca param'api ca passati lokaṃ.

59848.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of samita

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi māro pāpimā satataṃ samitaṃ paccupaṭṭhito, app'eva nām'āhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ
pūraṇo, bho gotama, kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti, carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti.

59849.meaning1: who is at peace; who is cooled; (comm) who has cooled evil

examples.text: samitāvi pahāya puññapāpaṃ, virajo ñatvā imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, jātimaraṇaṃ upātivatto, samaṇo tādi pavuccate tath'attā.
tasmā have lokavidū sumedho, lok'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.
dantaṃ nayanti samitiṃ, dantaṃ rāj'ābhirūhati, danto seṭṭho manussesu, yo'tivākyaṃ titikkhati.
ñātīhi mittehi ca bandhavehi ca, balena vaṇṇena sukhena c'ūbhayaṃ, kathaṃ na hāyeyyuṃ pare'ti icchati, idaṃ samiddhañ'ca ca pan'ābhikaṅkhati.
na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.

59855.commentary: (MNa) samiddhī'ti tassa kira therassa attabhāvo samiddho abhirūpo pāsādiko, tasmā samiddhi'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gato.
59855.notes: Theragāthā verse 46 (TH1.46, TH46) is attributed to him.

examples.text: atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ tap'odaṃ obhāsetvā yen'āyasmā samiddhi ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā samiddhitthero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

59858.meaningLit: discourse on Samiddhi's question about suffering
59858.sanskrit: saṃsiddhi, samṛddhi + duḥkha + praśna + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

59859.meaningLit: discourse on Samiddhi's question about the world
59859.sanskrit: saṃsiddhi, samṛddhi + loka + praśna + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

59860.meaningLit: discourse on Samiddhi's question about being
59860.sanskrit: saṃsiddhi, samṛddhi + sattva + praśna + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

59864.commentary: (MNa) samihitan'ti samupabyūḷhaṃ rāsikataṃ, piṇḍaṃ katvā ṭhapitan'ti attho.

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, ye'pi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam'idaṃ eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitam'anubhāsanti vācitam'anuvācenti
sumatikataṃ [sumattikataṃ, ettha matisaddo kaṭṭhakhettassa samīkaraṇasādhane dārubhaṇḍe vattatī'ti sakkata-abhidhānesu āgataṃ. taṃ matiyā suṭṭhu samīkatan'ti aṭṭhakathāya sameti]

paṭivuttaṃ nāma udakavappe bījehi appatiṭṭhit'okāse pāṇakehi vināsitabīje vā okāse puna bījaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā udakena āsittaṃ, thalavappe visamapatitānaṃ vā bījānaṃ samakaraṇ'atthāya puna aṭṭhadantakena samīkataṃ, tesu aññataraṃ sandhāya esā āha.

59868.meaning2: having the essential function of equating

examples.text: sumatikataṃ [sumattikataṃ, ettha matisaddo kaṭṭhakhettassa samīkaraṇasādhane dārubhaṇḍe vattatī'ti sakkata-abhidhānesu āgataṃ. taṃ matiyā suṭṭhu samīkatan'ti aṭṭhakathāya sameti].

59871.meaning1: name of a wainwright in Sāvatthī

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena samīti yānakāraputto rathassa nemiṃ tacchati. tam'enaṃ paṇḍuputto ājīvako purāṇayānakāraputto paccupaṭṭhito hoti.

59872.meaning1: (in space or time) near; close; proximate to

examples.text: 419, 469. samīpe'jjatanī.
ajjappabhuti atīte kāle paccakkhe vā apaccakkhe vā samīpe ajjatanīvibhatti hoti. so maggaṃ agamī, te maggaṃ agamuṃ.

59875.commentary: (DNa) upaṭṭhāko santik'āvacaro'ti upaṭṭhāko hutvā santik'āvacaro, na randhagavesī. na vīmaṃsan'ādhippāyo. samīpacārī'ti idaṃ purimapadass'eva vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, bhavañ'hi ānando tassa bhoto gotamassa dīgharattaṃ upaṭṭhāko santik'āvacaro samīpacārī.

59877.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of samīpa (+gen)

examples.text: kataññunā me bhavituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti ekaṃ satasahassaṃ gāhāpetvā cūḷaseṭṭhissa samīpaṃ gato

59878.grammar: ind, prep, loc sg of samīpa (+gen)
59878.synonym: abhito, upanissāya, nissāya, santikaṃ, santike, sāmantā

examples.text: nagarassa samīpe pavattati kathā iti upanagaraṃ, darathānaṃ abhāvo niddarathaṃ, makasānaṃ abhāvo nimmakasaṃ, vuḍḍhānaṃ paṭipāṭi yathāvuḍḍhaṃ
bhikkhunīnam'ovādo pana samīpe tāsaṃ n'atthitāya n'atthi.
selo yathā ekaghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ nindāpasaṃsāsu, na samiñjanti paṇḍitā.
selo yathā ekagghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ rūpā rasā saddā, gandhā phassā ca kevalā, iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca, nappavedhenti tādino.
moghañ'c'assa hutaṃ hoti, moghañ'c'āpi samīhitaṃ, atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, eko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.

59891.meaning1: prominent; elevated; in a high position (in)

examples.text: y'āhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho, rañño aṅgassa paddhagū, sv'ājja dhammesu ukkaṭṭho, soṇo dukkhassa pāragū.
yo c'attānaṃ samukkaṃse, pare ca m'avajānāti, nihīno sena mānena, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

59893.synonym: ukkaṃsati, ukkaṃseti, pasaṃsati, vaṇṇeti, samukkaṃsati, saṃvaṇṇeti

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, dīghanakho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ukkaṃseti me bhavaṃ gotamo diṭṭhigataṃ, samukkaṃseti me bhavaṃ gotamo diṭṭhigatan'ti.

59894.grammar: pp of caus of saṃ ud √kheṭ
59894.commentary: (VINa) samukkheṭito'ti idaṃ suṭṭhu uttāsetvā aṇusahagatassā'pi puna anallīyanabhāvadassanavasena vuttan'ti.

59895.meaning1: fact of having frightened away; fact of having scared off
59895.construction:
saṃ + ud + kheṭe + ita + tta
samukkheṭita + tta
